limits.singleplayer: Local-slot logic has portable coverage. Native food/geometry checks use synthetic actors on a headless authority, not two physical split-screen controllers.
limits.compatibility: Vanilla Build 42.21, no dependencies. A mod that replaces eat completion without chaining can block the feature.
limits.performance: 32-call batch averages from a 1ms native clock. Whole-JVM retained heap, not Lua-only allocations. Synthetic 2/16/64 native players test scaling, not 64 network connections. No custom per-frame render or idle hook.
